headline: Asian markets close mixed as oil prices rise | Novini.bg
summary: Oil prices continued to rise and Asian stocks were mixed on Tuesday after violence resumed in the war in Iran following more than a month without significant combat. Uncertainty about the conflict's future increased.
why: Iran is a major oil producer, and conflict affecting the region's supply routes feeds directly into global crude prices and energy-sensitive equities.
why_moved: Renewed fighting in Iran raises concern about oil supply, pushing crude higher and weighing on Asian equities.
